description: This file defines the EmploymentStatusDao class, which provides data access methods for the EmploymentStatus entity, including retrieval, saving, deletion, and search functionalities within the Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: EmploymentStatusDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for EmploymentStatus entity, providing methods to interact with the database for employment status records.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmploymentStatus entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmploymentStatusIds
methods.description: Returns a list of IDs for existing employment statuses matching given IDs.

methods.name: saveEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Persists an EmploymentStatus entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Deletes EmploymentStatus records with specified IDs.

methods.name: searchEmploymentStatus
methods.description: Searches for employment statuses based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmploymentStatusPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for searching employment statuses with applied filters and pagination.

methods.name: getSearchEmploymentStatusesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employment statuses matching search filters.
